title: [ingest] Dedup decisions at a 0.45 similarity threshold
summary: Decision extraction treats candidates as duplicates once similarity crosses 0.45. That threshold controls how aggressively the ingest pipeline collapses near-duplicate notes, so it directly shapes KB noise and recall.
